description: THE machine-readable hold state for every scheduled external-action surface (likes, comments, follows, DMs, emails, form submits). authority-check.py reads this FIRST (step 0), before AUTHORITY.json, tripwires, and the log tail. An active hold here denies the pass at BOTH build time (cron body runs authority-check.py before discovery/job build) and dispatch time (run_*_pass.sh runs authority-check.py before anything reaches the Pig). Prose in the engagement-md headers NEVER creates or clears a hold: it is documentation only. This file is the hold mechanism. Writers: set-hold.py with --by owner (explicit Nolan binding order, ref recorded) or --by tripwire (platform flag: checkpoint/warning/action block/restriction, evidence ref recorded). No scheduled worker, cron body, or agent run may set or clear a hold on its own initiative. Nolan's 2026-09-30 ~16:05 standing rule: NEVER freeze engagement on prose/policy grounds; scale back ONLY on a platform flag. A failed pass is retried until the objective is met; a hold is the only thing that stops a surface, and it lives here.
